methods_quotes.q: In this opt-in survey, provider attitudes toward the current pneumococcal vaccination recommendations and potential updates were assessed through open-ended responses and 5-point Likert scales
The survey also assessed knowledge about pneumococcal vaccination recommendations via multiple choice and true or false questions.
